sloka: वर्तमाने महाघोरे सङ्ग्रामे रोमहर्षणे ।रुधिरोदा महाघोरा नद्यस्तत्र प्रसुस्रुवुः ।। ६.४४.११ ।।।।
transliteration: vartamāne mahāghore saṅgrāme romaharṣaṇe ।rudhirodā mahāghorā nadyastatra prasusruvuḥ ।। 6.44.11 ।।।।

translations.english: In that way as the war was going on, and rivers of blood flowing with the terrific noise it made hair stand on end.
